title: [Solved] Pepperstone Crypto Withdrawal & Support Issues
body:
*Solved. Unsure of issue however u believe one commenter below is correct about manual approvals for first withdrawals however it has never happened at any other site before
Hi all,
Signed up to pepperstone because of the sweet cash back shopback deal (recommended from here, cheers) however I decided to use the site for the Porsche competition (trade an amount) and i bought some crypto.
Buying it straight forward, withdrawing it to another wallet has made the withdrawing stuck on Pending. (It's been hours)
So naturally I contacted their 24/7 support team (over 6 hours of no response, even put a second one in)
Has anyone has any issues with this company before?
It's got my worried about my other money in their platform.
Thanks for any help and support fellow Ozbargainers.
